instruction: I want to install Markdown All in One extension on VS Code for better Markdown editing.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Markdown All in One extension for VS Code (extension ID: yzhang.markdown-all-in-one). Evaluator checks if the extension appears in the output of 'code --list-extensions' command.

Metric logic is correct: checks if the extension ID 'yzhang.markdown-all-in-one' is contained in the command output using string containment check.

Coverage is complete: instruction has single requirement (install extension), evaluator verifies exactly that requirement (extension is installed).
Data flow is correct: VM command executes -> returns extension list -> metric checks for specific extension ID -> returns 1.0 if found, 0.0 otherwise.
